related_actions.name: access_actions
related_actions.description: Returns the list of available actions, their metadata and usage. Read-only.
related_actions.safety: Do not expose internal endpoints, secrets, or credentials. Only return public metadata.

related_actions.name: access_memory
related_actions.description: Reads or writes persistent memory entries used for long-term context.
related_actions.safety: Require explicit user consent before accessing personal data. Enforce validation and ACLs. Persist only within approved memory root.

related_actions.name: access_short_memory
related_actions.description: Reads or writes ephemeral session-scoped memory (short-lived).
related_actions.safety: Ephemeral only. Never persist beyond session unless explicitly authorized. Do not store sensitive personal data without consent.

related_actions.name: get_action_function
related_actions.description: Returns a sanitized representation of the implementation/signature of the named action so the AI can understand how to invoke it programmatically.

returns.description: Sanitized action information suitable for AI use.

related_actions.safety: Return only sanitized metadata; never reveal secrets, credentials, internal endpoints, or raw implementation code. Enforce ACLs and explicit user authorization for restricted actions.

actions.name: keyboard_macro
actions.description: Sends synthetic keyboard input (shortcuts, typing, navigation keys) to the focused application.

params.sequence: array (required) — ordered steps; each step can be a string like 'ctrl+c', 'ctrl+v', 'tab', 'win', or an object {"type":"text","value":"..."} to type literal text.
params.delay_ms: number (optional) — milliseconds to wait between steps (default: 50).
params.repeat: number (optional) — how many times to repeat the sequence (default: 1)
params.target_window: string (optional) — identifier/title of window to focus before sending keys; if omitted, sends to current focus.

actions.safety: Require explicit user consent before executing. Disallow automation of sensitive actions (typing passwords, confirming destructive dialogs, sequences that trigger privilege elevation). Block or prompt for any system-critical combinations (e.g., ctrl+alt+del). Operate only on user-approved target windows and log actions for audit.

actions.name: web_search
actions.description: Performs a real internet search using the local browserless API or serpapi, returns processed results to the AI.
actions.safety: No personal data may be sent unless user asked.

actions.name: browser_open_url
actions.description: Opens the default system browser to a specific URL.

actions.name: browser_interact
actions.description: Uses Browser-Control API to navigate the web headlessly (click, type, extract text).

actions.name: open_program
actions.description: Opens a Windows program using its executable name.
actions.safety: Block critical system executables (cmd.exe, powershell.exe elevated, diskpart...).

actions.name: open_file
actions.description: Opens a file inside the shared folder.
actions.safety: Only files inside shared folder allowed.

actions.name: read_file
actions.description: Reads a text file and returns its content to the AI.
actions.safety: Read-only. Must stay inside memory root.

actions.name: write_file
actions.description: Writes or edits content in a file. Used by the AI to modify context, memory, actions.
actions.safety: Validate modifications using rules before writing. Never allow system-level overwrite.

actions.name: append_file
actions.description: Appends content to an existing file.

actions.name: 3d_generate_model
actions.description: Uses Meshy API to generate a 3D model from a prompt. Saves the .obj/.stl into projects folder.

actions.name: 3d_slice_model
actions.description: Uses Bambu Studio command line or API to slice a model to .gcode.

actions.name: 3d_send_to_printer
actions.description: Sends the G-code to the Bambu Lab printer via its LAN API.

actions.name: create_project
actions.description: Initialize a programming project folder with boilerplate files.

actions.name: add_code_file
actions.description: Adds or edits a code file inside a project.

actions.name: run_project
actions.description: Runs a programming project (Python, Node, C#, etc.).

actions.name: webcam_image_recognition
actions.description: Captura una imagen desde la webcam y la analiza para reconocer objetos, personas o identificar al usuario.

confidence_threshold.description: Nivel mínimo de confianza requerido para aceptar una detección.

fields.image_path: Ruta temporal donde se guardó la captura.
fields.detections: Lista de objetos/personas detectados con coordenadas, nombre y confianza.

notes: Solo analiza contenido visible en la webcam que el usuario explícitamente permite.
Nunca usa el reconocimiento facial para acciones sensibles sin autorización del usuario.
